news.title: South Africa's Auto Industry Threatened By Worsening Port Delays
news.summary: Congestion at Durban's main container terminal is putting growing strain on South Africa's automotive sector.
news.why: Shipments via Durban need extra lead time; consider alternative South African gateways.

news.title: Taiwan's Foxconn Bullish on Outlook But Warns About Supply Chain Tightness
news.summary: Foxconn is optimistic about demand but flags industry-wide shortages in chips, memory and certain key components.
news.why: Electronics buyers should confirm component allocations and lead times for Q1 builds now.

news.title: Spot rates jump ahead of holidays
news.summary: Truckload spot rates are climbing earlier than usual this season, raising questions about whether shipper strategies contributed.
news.why: Lock in contract capacity for late-November loads now; spot exposure is getting expensive.

news.title: Oil Tanker On Fire After Hitting Mine In Hormuz
news.summary: Iranian sources say a tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine in the eastern Strait of Hormuz; the report was not independently verified.
news.why: Gulf security incidents feed directly into war-risk insurance premiums and bunker costs.

news.title: Gulf Oil Exports Recover as Hormuz Shipping Struggles
news.summary: Gulf oil exports are rebounding, but Strait of Hormuz traffic remains roughly 65% below pre-conflict levels.
news.why: Reduced Hormuz traffic keeps Middle East routings and surcharges elevated.

news.title: Back-to-Back Million+ TEU Months at PoLA Set Record
news.summary: The Port of Los Angeles handled nearly 5 million TEUs from June through October, its strongest five-month run on record.
news.why: Record volumes plus long rail dwell times point to congestion risk for West Coast routings.

news.title: USPS readies 2027 rate increase, permanent fuel surcharge
news.summary: The Postal Service plans an average 5.9% price increase in January for products such as Ground Advantage and Priority Mail, plus a permanent fuel surcharge.
news.why: E-commerce shippers should re-run 2027 parcel budgets and compare regional carriers before January.

news.title: FTC Urged to Probe Companies Not Sharing Tariff Refunds With Consumers
news.summary: Pressure is mounting on the FTC to investigate whether companies are passing some of about $166 billion in tariff refunds on to consumers.
news.why: Importers receiving refunds should document how they are accounted for and priced.

news.title: Trump To Extend Shipping Waiver For Oil, Fertilizer For 90 Days
news.summary: A 90-day extension lets foreign-flagged vessels keep carrying oil and other commodities between U.S. ports.
news.why: Extra domestic tanker capacity should help steady fuel and fertilizer delivered costs for U.S. buyers through the winter.

news.title: MSC Nears Deal To Buy Majority Stake In German Shipyard Meyer Werft
news.summary: German authorities are close to an agreement that would let MSC acquire roughly 80% of the Meyer Werft shipyard.
news.why: MSC keeps widening its reach across shipping and shipbuilding, which further concentrates bargaining power with the largest carrier.

news.title: Nvidia's Asian Supply Chain Prepares for Life after Huang
news.summary: Nvidia's Asian suppliers are preparing for a leadership transition that could remove one of AI's most prominent advocates.
news.why: Electronics buyers dependent on AI-server components should watch for shifts in Nvidia's allocation and supplier priorities under new leadership.

news.title: CMA CGM Net Profit More Than Triples to $2.32 Billion as Freight Rates Surge
news.summary: The French container line's third-quarter earnings jumped to $2.32 billion on the back of stronger box rates and healthy cargo volumes.
news.why: Carriers with this much pricing power are unlikely to discount 2027 contracts, so shippers should lock in allocations early and benchmark against spot.

news.title: Hapag-Lloyd Profit Surges as Freight Rates Rise, Red Sea Services Return
news.summary: Hapag-Lloyd posted a sharp Q3 earnings gain as higher rates outweighed conflict-related cost increases, while some Red Sea routings resume.
news.why: A return to Suez routings could trim Asia–Europe transit times, but importers should confirm each service's routing before promising earlier delivery dates.

news.title: Singapore-Flagged Bulk Carrier Strikes Delaware River Bridge, Coast Guard Investigating
news.summary: A bulk ship hit the Tacony-Palmyra Bridge near Philadelphia, temporarily leaving its movable span stuck while the Coast Guard inspected it.
news.why: Shippers routing through Delaware River terminals should watch for vessel or road restrictions that could delay pickups in the Philadelphia area.

market.name: Ocean freight producer prices (deep sea PPI)
